digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: Tech, AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design, Data

stories.headline: Amazon Acquires AI Startup Decart for $7.5 Billion
stories.blurb: Amazon is purchasing AI optimization startup Decart to enhance its custom chip performance and accelerate frontier model training workloads.

stories.headline: Riemann Hypothesis Formally Verified in Lean Proof Assistant
stories.blurb: Mathematicians released a 17-million-line Lean code library formally validating the proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, marking a landmark achievement for computer-verified mathematics.

stories.headline: METR Reports Rapid Acceleration in AI Task Horizons
stories.blurb: METR benchmarks reveal that the autonomous task length frontier AI models can complete doubles every 3.6 months, accelerating the potential arrival of automated AI research.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Releases Open-Weight Inkling 2 Mini
stories.blurb: Thinking Machines launched Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4-billion-parameter open model that re-executes middle layers to outperform sub-100B competitors on coding benchmarks.

stories.headline: Leaky AI Supply Chain Exposes Millions of User Credentials
stories.blurb: A canary research project revealed that multiple third-party AI proxy providers and inference vendors are actively logging, exposing, and mishandling secret API keys and user prompts.

stories.headline: Autonomous AI Agent Discovers and Exploits Zero-Day in 11 Minutes
stories.blurb: AWS security researchers observed an autonomous AI agent independently discover a path traversal zero-day vulnerability and escalate it to a root reverse shell without human intervention.

stories.headline: Signal Blocks System AI Assistants from Capturing Screenshots
stories.blurb: Signal updated its mobile applications to block screen captures whenever OS-level AI features like Siri or Gemini attempt to read private conversation text.

stories.headline: Microsoft Fixes Entra Connect Health Flaw Exploited by Hackers
stories.blurb: Attackers exploited an API vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to harvest administrator contact information, exposing enterprise tenants to targeted phishing risks.

stories.headline: PostgreSQL 19 Released with Non-Blocking Space Reclamation
stories.blurb: PostgreSQL 19 introduces zero-downtime disk space recovery, simplified logical replication setup, and improved query planner controls for multi-tenant environments.

stories.headline: Google Donates Agent Substrate and gVisor to CNCF
stories.blurb: Google is transferring its agent isolation framework and gVisor sandboxing technology to the CNCF to establish open standards for securely running AI agents at scale.

stories.headline: Google Launches Sidecar-Less Ambient Networking on GKE
stories.blurb: Google Kubernetes Engine now supports ambient networking in general availability, decoupling service mesh capabilities from application pods to significantly reduce memory and CPU overhead.

stories.headline: Datadog Redesigns Engine to Eliminate Metric Stream Recovery Bottlenecks
stories.blurb: Datadog scaled its metric processing infrastructure by shifting aggregation reconciliation into historical storage, allowing worker nodes to recover instantly at the live edge.

stories.headline: Google Labs Unveils Stitch Loop for Automated Product Maintenance
stories.blurb: Google Labs launched Stitch Loop, an experimental AI agent that monitors live production metrics and code repositories to autonomously open bug fix, accessibility, and security pull requests.

stories.headline: Google Play to Require Foldable App Optimization by 2027
stories.blurb: Google Play announced mandatory baseline standards for Android apps to support foldable displays, multi-windowing, and dynamic posture changes starting in April 2027.

stories.headline: Designing Enterprise Interfaces Around Exception Management
stories.blurb: Operational dashboards become significantly more effective when designed to surface actionable anomalies instead of forcing users to browse exhaustive tables of normal system state.
